items.name: Slap
items.description: An average hand to slap thieves and send them flying!
items.use: A stronger alternative to the default Baseball Bat - allows you to smack thieves and return your brainrots. It has longer range than the bat.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Speed Coil
items.description: Zoom around the map with additional speed.
items.use: While equipped, increases your move speed by 50% (from 34 to 51).
items.sound: When the player equips in hand: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Speed_coil_sound.mp3

items.name: Trap
items.description: Place traps that freeze thieves for 7 seconds
items.use: They can be placed on the ground anywhere on the map and can trigger as soon as they are placed. Each player can have up to 5 Traps in the combined space of the map and/or their inventory (for example, there can be a maximum of 5 only on the map, 5 only in the inventory, or anywhere in between such as 2 on the map and 3 in the inventory). If the maximum has been reached, the player will not be able to buy any more Traps until one gets triggered. Note that other players can move around or over placed Traps.
items.sound: When the player gets stuck: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Trap_sound.mp3

items.name: Iron Slap
items.description: Heavy iron slap that knocks players flying!
items.use: Stronger version of the Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Gravity Coil
items.description: Reduced gravity coil lets you jump extra high!
items.use: While equipped, increases your jump height by 100% (from 7.2 to 14.4). Also reduces your gravity, making you fall slower.
items.sound: When the player equips it in the hand: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Gravity_coil_sound.mp3

items.name: Bee Launcher
items.description: Release bees to attack your opponent and invert their controls!
items.use: Reverses affected player's controls, zooms their FOV, and applies a yellow tint to their vision. Bees can be seen flying around the affected player. The effect lasts 5 seconds.
items.sound: The sound of the player affected by the Bee Launcher: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Bee_launcher_sound.mp3

items.name: Gold Slap
items.description: Powerful golden slap that knocks enemies farther back.
items.use: Stronger version of the Iron Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Coil Combo
items.description: Speed and jump coil combined for a double boost.
items.use: Provides the effects of the Speed and Gravity Coils at the same time.
items.sound: When the player equips: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Coil_combo_sound.mp3

items.name: Rage Table
items.description: Throw a table to fling players and return your Brainrots.
items.use: When used, a screaming sound is made and a table spawns in front of the player. After a short delay, the table moves in the direction the item was used and goes a short distance. Other players who touch the table will be ragdolled.
items.sound: The sound when the table is thrown: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Rage_table_sound.mp3

items.name: Diamond Slap
items.description: Charge up* a diamond slap to knock others away. *This text is misleading because it cannot actually be charged.
items.use: Stronger version of the Gold Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Grapple Gun
items.description: Swing across the map with speed!
items.use: Shoots a grappling hook that pulls the player to the point where the hook collided with an object, which can be used to efficiently reach certain places.
items.sound: When the hook hits something: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Grapple-hook-sound.mp3

items.name: Taser
items.description: Stun enemies with a taser to fling them and return your Brainrots.
items.use: Forces affected player into ragdoll mode for 3 seconds.
items.sound: When the taser gun hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Taser-gun-sound.mp3

items.name: Emerald Slap
items.description: Gem-infused slap that sends enemies flying with extra force.
items.use: Stronger version of the Diamond Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Invisibility Cloak
items.description: Cloak yourself to vanish and sprint at super speed.
items.use: When used, turns you invisible and increases your speed by 100% (from 34 to 68). The effect lasts until the item is used again or unequipped.
items.sound: When it makes the player invisible: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Invisibility-cloak-sound.mp3 When it makes the player visible: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Invisibility-cloak-sound-2.mp3

items.name: Boogie Bomb
items.description: Throw this at thieves to make them dance!
items.use: When touched by another player, it explodes, causing all players in the area of effect to drop any held Brainrots and start dancing (more specifically, performing Fortnite's "Take the L" dance) for 10 seconds. The affected players's FOV also constantly changes.
items.sound: When the player is affected by the boogie bomb: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Boogie-Bomb_sound.mp3

items.name: Ruby Slap
items.description: Ultimate ruby-powered slap sends enemies flying far.
items.use: Stronger version of the Emerald Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Medusa’s Head
items.description: Turn enemies into stone and recover stolen brainrots. Turns all other players in the area of effect into stone, making them immobile and unable to use some gears for 3 seconds. Players enter ragdoll mode when the effect ends.
items.use: 5 rebirths required
items.sound: When Medusa's head is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Medusa_s-head-sound.mp3

items.name: Dark Matter Slap
items.description: Send enemies flying with the power of dark matter.
items.use: Stronger version of the Ruby Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Web Slinger
items.description: Pull enemies and trap them close to you! Use this in many ways to your advantage..
items.use: Shoots out a web, which tangles hit players. The tangled players are immobile for 10 seconds, and can be pulled by you. Players caught in the web will not be able to use gears.
items.sound: When the Web Slinger is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Web_slinger_sound.mp3 When the Web Slinger hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Web-slinger-sound-2.mp3 When the Web Slinger cooldown ends: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Web_slinger_sound_3.mp3

items.name: Flame Slap
items.description: Burn your enemies while sending them flying.
items.use: Stronger version of the Dark Matter Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Quantum Cloner
items.description: Clone yourself and use this tool as a decoy or for other reasons.
items.use: Creates an NPC clone of your character that occasionally moves around short distances. You can swap places with the NPC at any time. The cooldown for swapping positions with the clone and placing it is 10 seconds.
items.sound: When the clone is summoned: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Quantum_cloner_sound.mp3 When the player switches positions with the clone: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Quantum_cloner_sound_2.mp3

items.name: All-Seeing Sentry
items.description: Use this sentry turret as means of automated protection for you and your items.
items.use: Creates a sentry, which after 5 seconds of preparation will start automatically shooting other players that get in its range (even through walls or invisible players). It lasts for up to 1 minute and can be destroyed using Slap tools.
items.sound: When the sentry is placed: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:All_seeing_sentry_sound.mp3 When the sentry is ready: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:All_seeing_sentry_2_sound.mp3 When the sentry shoots: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:All_seeing_sentry_3_sound.mp3

items.name: Nuclear Slap
items.description: A radioactive slap that explodes with nuclear force.
items.use: Stronger version of the Flame Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Rainbowrath Sword
items.description: It may shine like a rainbow, but it strikes like thunder.
items.use: The Rainbowrath Sword has a higher swing cooldown than the slaps, however every third swing, you lunge forward, flinging any player in the way. Sometimes may glitch and kill the player hit.
items.sound: When the player equips the sword in their hand: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Rainbowrath-Sword-sound.mp3 When the player uses the sword: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Rainbowrath-Sword-sound-2.mp3

items.name: Galaxy Slap
items.description: Slap on every hit with star power. Cosmic blasts on every hit.
items.use: Stronger version of the Nuclear Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Laser Cape
items.description: Puts on cape. Shoots laser from eyes. X-ray vision.
items.use: While equipped, you can see invisible players and shoot lasers from your eyes. The shooting ability has a 1 second cooldown and the lasers have somewhat limited range. Also increases your move speed by approximately 50%.
items.sound: When the laser cape is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Laser-cape-sound.mp3

items.name: Glitched Slap
items.description: Corrupt reality. Unleash chaotic glitches with every step.
items.use: Stronger version of the Galaxy Slap.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3

items.name: Body Swap Potion
items.description: Switch souls. Trade bodies and confuse your foes.
items.use: Swaps your position with the affected player.
items.sound: When the position is swapped with another player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Body_Swap_potion_sound.mp3

items.name: Splatter Slap
items.description: Slap. Splash. Style.
items.use: Stronger version of the Glitch Slap. Splatters the slapped player's screen with paint for a short time.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hit_sound.mp3 When it hits a player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Hits_a_player.mp3|

items.name: Paintball Gun
items.description: A colorful weapon for playful defense and friendly battles.
items.use: Shoots paintball bullets that can travel far distances. When a paintball bullet hits a player, their speed is redcued by 60% (from 34 to 13.6) and a paint splatter appears on their screen, slightly limiting their view. If a player is hit 5 times in a row, they briefly go into ragdoll mode. The splatter stays on the player's screen for 5 seconds.
items.sound: When the player uses the paintball gun: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Paintball_gun_sound.mp3

items.name: Heart Balloon
items.description: Press and hold to inflate the balloon and float higher in the sky.
items.use: Allows you to float upwards, lasting 10 seconds. (Note: There is a height limit for the balloon; when it reaches the map’s height limit, the balloon will burst and the cooldown will start)
items.sound: When the player uses the balloon: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Heart_balloon_sound.mp3 When the player uses the balloon for more than 2 seconds and then stops using it: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Heart_balloon_sound_2.mp3 When the balloon pops: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Heart_balloon_sound_3.mp3

items.name: Magnet
items.description: Use a magnetic force to throw your enemies off or to help your allies!
items.use: When used on a player, a yellow energy emerges from the magnet to the player affected by it, and a type of "circle" will appear around the player. The player affected by the magnet will have difficulty moving and will be pulled toward the magnet in the player's hand.
items.sound: When the magnet attracts a person to it: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Magnet_sound.mp3

items.name: Megaphone
items.description: Jumpscare other players and ragdoll them!
items.use: Plays a loud sound, and ragdolls all players in the area of effect.
items.sound: When it is used: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Megaphone_sound.mp3

items.name: Beehive
items.description: Place this near your base for some extra defense
items.use: The player can therefore place it on the ground, and it lasts 60 seconds. The player who placed it on the ground cannot remove it until it ends. It works similarly to the Bee Launcher and the Sentinel. When placed, all nearby enemy players will have bees on their bodies, their controls become inverted (for example: you move to the right, but go to the left), their screen takes on a yellow tint, and their FOV zooms in. The effect lasts 5 seconds, and the hive cannot be destroyed by any player.
items.sound: Sound of the player affected by the beehive: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Bee_launcher_sound.mp3

items.name: Gummy Slap
items.description: Slap other players with a gummy bear, freezing them inside one on impact!
items.use: Improved version of the Splatter Slap. Also freezes the hit player inside of a gummy bear for 3 seconds, preventing them from moving or using Gears.
items.sound: TBA

items.name: Subspace Mine
items.description: Hide these around our* base for extra defense on your best Brainrots! Place a max of 2 at once.*Typo, likely meant to say "your".
items.use: They can be placed on the groud, becoming invisible shortly after (though the particles can still be seen). Up to a maximum of 2 mines from the same player can exist at the same time. If the player attempts to place a third one, the one placed earliest will disappear. If another player comes into contact with it when it is fully invisible, the mine explodes in an area. All players affected by the explosion will get a purple aura, have an item unqeuipped from their hand, thrown far away, and ragdolled for 9 seconds. The cooldown is 15 seconds for the first mine and 20 seconds for the second one.
items.sound: When the mine is placed: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Subspace_mine_sound.mp3 When the player steps on the mine: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Subspace_mine_sound_2.mp3

items.name: Heatseeker
items.description: Auto lock on opponents and fire a missile to chase them down
items.use: When equipped, when the nearest player enters the missile's range, a red square will appear over the nearest player. When used, fires a guided missile at the target that explodes on impact. If the missile does not hit the target within 5 seconds, it disappears. The weapon can detect invisible players within its range, and the player holding the weapon can enter ragdoll mode even if it's their own weapon.
items.sound: When it doesn't detect the player (loop):https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Heatseeker_sound.mp3 When it detects the player (loop): https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Heatseeker_sound_2.mp3 When the missile hits the player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Heatseeker_sound_3.mp3

items.name: Attack Doge
items.description: Unleash your attack doge to defend you from your enemies
items.use: When used, it spawns a companion dog by your side. If the dog doesn't see any player within its range, it follows the owner. When a different player comes within the dog's range, the dog runs to that player, and if the player touches the dog, the player will go into ragdoll mode. The other player can destroy the dog by hitting it with some gear (like a slap or another gear). The dog disappears after 11 seconds if no one destroys it.
items.sound: When the doge is summoned: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Attack_doge_sound.mp3 When the doge chases the player: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/File:Attack_doge_sound_2.mp3

items.name: Giant potion
items.description: Tower over your opponents!
items.use: When used, the player drinks the potion and becomes huge (about 4x bigger), the player will have light green particles around them and most of the gears will also become huge. The huge player becomes immune to ragdoll and has a higher jump, and the giant effect lasts 20 seconds. After 20 seconds, the player returns to normal size.
items.sound: TBA
